_comment: Test suites for tools/test_layouts.py. A case is a widget at its 10-inch size; "{role}" values are replaced from an entity map (tools/test_layout_entities_demo.json, or a local one with real entities). A page case ("page") is a whole energy or house page. Order is placement order. Gallery metadata selects stable gallery tiles; gallery_only cases never enter test suites or their generated edge/state cases.

energy_timeline.Domain: sensor (cumulative kWh counters read from Recorder statistics)
energy_timeline.Roles: entity_id grid import (required), secondary grid export, tertiary solar production, optional battery charge and discharge counters, battery level (battery_soc_entity_id) and a Solcast forecast (forecast_today_entity_id)
energy_timeline.Notes: up to four rings (home use, feed-in, solar production, battery level); bars: 96 slots of 15 minutes, home use stacked by source (solar, battery, grid) above the axis, feed-in and battery charging below, the forecast as a line; gaps stay gaps; the split is an estimate and is labelled so in the popup
energy_timeline.Interaction: tap opens a details popup with the measured counters and the estimated mix
energy_timeline.Size: min 300x200, up to the whole content area

solar_forecast.Domain: sensor x5 (today, tomorrow, day 3-5, whole numbers)

heating_tile.Display: style_variant: default (full arc), arc_semi (semi arc + mode buttons)
heating_tile.Options: arc_semi only: arc_opening (left, right, top, bottom)
heating_tile.Interaction: tapping the card toggles the climate entity on/off directly; the +/- buttons step the target temperature directly -- no popup either way

weather.Options: weather entity and optional Show name (off by default)
weather.Interaction: tap opens current weather details and the optional DWD report
weather.Extras: Today’s low and precipitation when space permits; the same colored Meteocons as the forecast on P4

weather_hourly.Options: weather_hourly: show up to 24 upcoming hours, horizontally scrollable
weather_hourly.Extras: secondary_entity_id: optional DWD weather report sensor
weather_hourly.Interaction: tap opens current weather details and report

weather_2.Toggles: show_precipitation (rain chance and amount, default on)
weather_2.Extras: secondary_entity_id: an optional DWD weather report sensor, shown as a summary line in the header if there is room (needs roughly 150x40 px free there, so a wider tile) and per-day in the day popup
weather_2.Interaction: tapping a day card opens a popup (pressure, wind, UV, the report text)

light_tile.Options: brightness, color temperature, RGB and effects (only when Home Assistant reports the capability)
light_tile.Interaction: the brightness bar is a direct touch slider; tapping the lamp icon toggles on/off directly; the color button opens color and effect controls

slider.Display: slider_direction: auto, left_to_right, right_to_left, bottom_to_top, top_to_bottom
slider.Interaction: drag or tap the bar directly sets the value (a real touch slider), no popup

scene_tile.Notes: momentary tile, flashes the accent color
scene_tile.Interaction: tap triggers the action directly, no popup

fan_tile.Display: flat (minus/power/plus) below 220 px height, large (turning rotor) above it
fan_tile.Options: one chip per speed step, oscillation, up to 3 preset modes -- all gated by supported_features
fan_tile.Interaction: minus/power/plus and every chip (speed step, oscillation, preset) tap directly, no popup

select_tile.Notes: shows the current option; the new one appears once Home Assistant reports it
select_tile.Interaction: tap opens a list of the entity's options; picking one calls select_option

datetime_tile.Display: localized date and/or time; seconds appear only when non-zero
datetime_tile.Interaction: tap opens date/time rollers; Save sends one HA service call

alarm_tile.States: disarmed, armed home/away/night/vacation/custom bypass, arming, pending, triggered (error colour)
alarm_tile.Options: alarm_actions: the arm and disarm actions the tile offers (default all the entity supports)
alarm_tile.Interaction: tap opens the action list, a PIN pad follows when the entity needs a code; optional history_popup opens on long press

sensor.Interaction: read-only; optional history_popup opens Recorder history on tap

contact_tile.Display: state words by device class, or an icon-only / door-window pictogram look
contact_tile.Interaction: read-only; optional history_popup opens Recorder history on tap

camera_tile.Interaction: tap refreshes the snapshot; with optional Live picture (MJPEG), tap opens full screen
camera_tile.Notes: snapshots refresh every 10s while on screen; MJPEG live mode is off by default; the preview shows a stylized placeholder picture, not a real camera

media_player.Interaction: the volume bar is a direct drag slider; minus/plus/play-pause buttons tap directly, no popup

sonos_favorites.Extras: secondary_entity_id: sensor.sonos_favorites, rendered as the list of favorite rows itself (one or two columns by name length), not a sub-label
sonos_favorites.Interaction: tapping a favorite plays it directly (media_play_media), no popup

button.Domain: switch, media_player (also scene/script/button/lock as a momentary trigger)
button.Display: button_mode: auto, play_pause, stop, next, previous
button.Interaction: tap triggers the action directly, no popup

gauge.Display: style_variant: linear (vertical bar), horizontal (bar filling left to right, title and value in one row above it), radial
gauge.Options: linear and horizontal: gauge_bar_style (smooth, segmented -- an LED-style column of gauge_segment_count blocks, 4-30, default 10; fewer on a column too short for them)
gauge.Extras: radial and horizontal: up to 2 extra readouts (secondary_entity_id, tertiary_entity_id) as small text -- under the value inside the arc, or in one row under the horizontal bar when the tile has room; not separate widgets

graph.Options: graph_time_window_min, graph_bar_bucket_min (bars only), graph_ha_history (24 h from the Home Assistant Recorder), graph_point_count (render points, empty = auto)

room_tile.Notes: room_extra_mode humidity: the chosen humidity sensor as the prominent extra readout

room_tile_2.Notes: room_extra_mode cover: state and position, a 44 px button opens or closes (Stop while moving, if supported)

room_tile_3.Notes: room_extra_mode media_player: playing/paused status and a Play/Pause button when supported

energy_timeline_2.Notes: style_variant nested: the rings inside each other (outermost the battery level, then feed-in, solar production, home use) with one row per value beside them; the timeline follows when the card is tall enough

car_widget.Extras: from 200 px width and 330 px height: precond_entity_id (switch/climate/button/select), lock_entity_id (lock or door binary sensor), interior_temp_entity_id -- all three render as a row of read-only labels/icons under the rings, except precond_entity_id which is a real button
car_widget.Interaction: read-only rings; the optional precond button (if configured) is directly tappable, lock and interior temperature are not
car_widget.Notes: range is always shown in km

cover_tile.Interaction: up/stop/down buttons tap directly; the position bar is a read-only indicator here, not a drag target -- for that, use the slider widget on the same cover entity instead (see the Slider row above)

vacuum_tile.Options: start/pause, stop, dock, suction level and cleaning mode pickers; optional inline map image; optional battery sensor (battery_entity_id, the only source of the charge since Home Assistant 2026.9; the editor suggests it for a new card)
vacuum_tile.Interaction: action buttons tap directly; the suction and mode chips open their pickers; the picture is read-only; with history_popup a long press on the card opens the last 24 hours of activity

room_tile_4.Domain: any (temperature, humidity, windows/doors, lights, presence, batteries)
room_tile_4.Extras: entity_id plus up to 7 more in room_entities; filled from a Home Assistant area in the editor
room_tile_4.Interaction: tap opens a popup listing every entity, with toggles for lights/switches/covers/fans/media players; with "Controls on the card" a large card also shows one button per device type (lights and switches toggle together, covers get up and down)

climate_tile.Options: current/target temperature (0.5 steps), mode, fan and swing chips when supported
climate_tile.Interaction: tapping a chip opens the corresponding mode, fan or swing picker

lock_tile.States: locked, unlocked, locking, unlocking, open, opening, jammed (error colour)
lock_tile.Options: lock_confirm: ask before unlocking or opening (default off); an Open button (lock.open) from 260 px width when the lock supports it
lock_tile.Interaction: tap locks or unlocks (a jammed lock is locked again); optional history_popup opens on long press

binary_tile.Display: display_mode: '' (text + since), icon, since; event.* shows 'Triggered'/'Last 5 min'
binary_tile.Interaction: read-only; optional history_popup opens Recorder history on tap

todo_list.Interaction: tapping a row toggles that item done, no popup
todo_list.Notes: open items first, completed ones below; the list is read from Home Assistant every few minutes and after a change

bambu_printer.Domain: sensor (print status of the Home Assistant Bambu Lab integration)
bambu_printer.Options: explicit entity bindings: nozzle and bed temperature, progress, remaining time, optional step and job name, optional pause, resume and stop buttons
bambu_printer.Interaction: Pause or Resume (one button) and Stop (after a confirmation) press the bound Home Assistant buttons; Status opens a read-only detail popup

wallbox_evcc.Display: status, power, charged energy, remaining time and current SOC on a solid green bar
wallbox_evcc.Interaction: Off requests charging stop; Smart/Fast choose modes; Vehicle changes assignment; Target SOC applies one value; Sessions lists completed charges

energy_price_forecast.Domain: sensor with a list attribute `data` (EPEX Spot, Day Ahead Optimizer, Tibber and Nord Pool template sensors)
energy_price_forecast.Display: one bar per interval, green below and orange above the average, past hours dimmed, the running interval outlined
energy_price_forecast.Options: price_selector: show Today and Tomorrow (one toggle button on a narrow tile); price_cheap_times: shade the cheap windows and name the next; price_line: a stepped line instead of filled bars; price_average: a fixed value instead of the day's own average, or a sensor in secondary_entity_id
energy_price_forecast.Extras: price now, interval, minimum and maximum; the cheap windows are the lowest quarter of the day's prices, at least one hour

parqet_portfolio.Domain: sensors of the Parqet Companion integration: the total value sensor, and optionally its gain, return, XIRR and dividends sensors
parqet_portfolio.Display: the total value, the gain in the currency and the return in percent, XIRR and dividends, and the largest holdings as weight bars as far as the tile is tall enough
parqet_portfolio.Options: parqet_hide_amounts: show percentages only, no amounts; parqet_selector: tabs (Performance, Holdings) and interval chips (1D, 1W, 1M, YTD, MAX) to change the view by touch; parqet_view and parqet_interval: the start view and interval (MAX are the sensors' own figures)
parqet_portfolio.Extras: the tile names the interval; the intervals 1D to YTD are asked from the integration (the reply of a large portfolio can exceed what the panel receives), MAX are the sensors' own figures

stock_quotes.Domain: Easy Stock sensors, up to eight
stock_quotes.Display: a list of name, price and the last session's change, a chart per quote with the change over the period, or a card per quote in columns with price, change and a chart
stock_quotes.Options: stock_view: list, chart or grid (tiles); stock_period: 1d, 1w, 30d, ytd or 1y; stock_delta: percent, absolute or both; stock_ticker: the symbol
stock_quotes.Extras: a tap opens the detail popup with five periods; histories come from Easy Stock's closes or Home Assistant's records
